thread:
sophie: Quick micro-thread  finalise site hero copy + webinar modal + inbound routing. Keep it short and testable.

marta: Love a three-verb approach: Launch (Hosted), Reserve (Dedicated), Protect (Private). Each hero should be one punchy sentence.

gabe: Draft hero lines:
- Hosted: "Ship inference fast  production latency, no surprises."
- Dedicated: "Reserve GPU capacity, meet SLOs."
- Private: "Keep models and data inside your network."

olivia: Webinar tagline: "Live benchmark + rollout playbook: latency, token cost, safe fallbacks." Two email subject options: "Benchmark: cut token costs without user impact" and "How we keep latency low at scale  live demo".

patrick: Social variants (X/Twitter style)  short and punchy:
1) "See a real benchmark: latency & cost cuts. Webinar Nov 7."
2) "Reduce token costs with smart batching & routing. Live demo."

ken: Routing snippet for Growth forms (pasteable):

```
if form.interest == "hosted": assign -> queue:sdr-hosted
elif form.interest == "dedicated": assign -> queue:sdr-dedicated
elif form.interest == "private": assign -> queue:sdr-enterprise
if utm_campaign contains "webinar" OR form.source == "social": add_tag -> webinar
hidden_field: benchmark_pdf_opt_in=true
if interest == "private" and company_size >= 250: set_flag -> needs-compliance-review
```

lauren: Add optional fields: primary_use_case (chat, embeddings, search, batch) and region (NA/EU/APAC). For APAC pages switch hero subcopy to "low latency" instead of specific ms.

marta: Feature bullets under hero (3):
- "Workload-aware batching & KV caching to lower unit costs"
- "Model variant routing for graceful fallbacks"
- "Token-level observability & rollout controls"

gabe: For the Dedicated landing, lead with "Reserved capacity & SLA" then the three bullets.

olivia: Modal teaser copy (short): "Watch a live benchmark of a chat workload. Well show before/after latency and a guided rollout." CTA A: "Reserve my seat" CTA B: "Send benchmark PDF".

patrick: CTA funnel mapping: Hosted -> "Get started" (signup), Dedicated -> "Request pilot" (sales), Private -> "Request security call" (longer form).

sophie: Owners: marta finalize hero lines; lauren add form fields; ken confirm any numbers if we decide to publish; patrick implement routing. Ill draft the PR and tag reviewers.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: copy-pass/launch-modal-social -> staging at 2024-11-07T17:00Z :white_check_mark:

sophie: I'll tag folks on PR once it's ready. Thanks everyone!
